External-source record for the crates.io package `proc-macro2` 1.0.106.

`build.rs` probes the compiler's proc-macro span support and emits `rustc-cfg` answers; the `OUT_DIR`
it touches holds no generated input the library includes. Which answers appear depends on the exact
compiler, which is why every record binds the toolchain. `proc_macro_span` is emitted only by a nightly
compiler or when `RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP` is present in the script's environment; a stable publisher that never
sets it observes the three answers below, and a harvest that ran with `RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP` set must not be
recorded as a fact of the toolchain.
